risk_summary: The disclosure provides meaningful quantitative detail on rate changes, delayed state payments, reimbursement reductions, membership, revenue, and medical expense development. However, it relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and broad uncertainty language, while the fragmented excerpt limits assessment of the full financial outlook. Key risks include state budget pressures, payment delays, Medicare reimbursement cuts, regulatory changes, and favorable prior-period reserve development.
